item.title: Roush 427 SRX-Powered 1967 Ford Mustang Fastback 5-Speed
item.description: This 1967 Ford Mustang was refurbished and customized by a previous owner around 2015. Highlighting the build is the Roush 427ci SRX V8, which is based on an iron four-bolt small block V8 and equipped with H-beam connecting rods, forged pistons, a roller camshaft, aluminum heads, an aluminum Edelbrock intake manifold, and a Holley carburetor. item.description: This 2006 Porsche 911 Carrera S cabriolet spent five years with its original owner before it spent the next 15 years with its second owner, and it has been registered in California since new. The car was ordered with the Sport Chrono Package Plus, the Bose High End Sound Package, auto-dimming mirrors, heated front seats, and a sport shifter and steering wheel, and it was specified in Arctic Silver Metallic over a Black full leather interior. item.description: This 2006 Pontiac GTO was specified in Phantom Black Metallic over black leather, and it has 46k miles. item.title: 1967 Shelby Mustang GT500
item.description: This 1967 Shelby Mustang GT500 fastback is one of 2,048 examples produced for the model year and was shipped to Sexton Ford Sales on March 22, 1967. The car was restored in the 1990s and was acquired by the selling dealer in 2026. It is finished in Dark Moss Green over black vinyl and is powered by a replacement 428ci FE V8 linked with a four-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential. item.description: This Mercedes-Benz 300SL Gullwing replica was reportedly partially produced by Quint Motorcars in the 1980s before being completed by Tony Ostermeier's Gullwing Cars of Gardena, California, circa 1990. item.description: This 2016 Porsche 911 R is #740 of 991 examples manufactured during a single model year, and its body has been fitted with a "BP World Record" livery, paying homage to multiple endurance records set by the 1967 911 R at Italy's Monza circuit.
